name: check
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check

name: proof-tests
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test kernel core/count-recovery core/count-cases.test.ts core/count-focus-proof.test.ts core/count-cert-grow.test.ts core/count-witness.test.ts core/field-laws.test.ts core/lemma-cuts.test.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/mldr.test.ts

name: support-tests
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test core/count-support.test.ts core/count-admission.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/relevance.test.ts core/support-order.test.ts

name: family-and-pipeline
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; GDP_COUNTS_SHARED_TREES=0 GDP_COUNT_LEMMA_CUTS=0 TRACK_M_FAMILY_TRACE=1 taskset -c 0-3 bun research/track-m/profile-family.ts replay-input/input.json; GDP_COUNT_LEMMA_CUTS=0 taskset -c 0-3 bun research/track-m/profile-production.ts production
